cards.name: El Gallo
cards.twist: Rooster crowing at a 3am phone glow
cards.story: Dawn never comes for the man who never sleeps; the rooster is only announcing the next scroll.
cards.grito_es: Canta el gallo, y tú: cinco minutitos más.
cards.grito_en: The rooster sings, and you say: five more little minutes.

cards.name: El Diablito
cards.twist: The corporate devil
cards.story: He doesn't steal souls anymore; he gets them to sign the onboarding form.
cards.grito_es: No pide tu alma, nomás tu firma.
cards.grito_en: He doesn't want your soul, just your signature.

cards.name: La Dama
cards.twist: The lady of the filter
cards.story: Her face is flawless because it is no longer hers.
cards.grito_es: Tan bonita que ya no es ella.
cards.grito_en: So pretty she isn't herself anymore.

cards.name: El Catrín
cards.twist: The skeletal dandy who sold you the future
cards.story: He's rich on paper, and the paper is yours.
cards.grito_es: Rico en papel, y el papel es tuyo.
cards.grito_en: Rich on paper, and the paper is yours.

cards.name: El Paraguas
cards.twist: Umbrella against a storm of notifications
cards.story: No umbrella was ever built for this kind of rain.
cards.grito_es: Llueven campanitas, no hay paraguas que aguante.
cards.grito_en: It's raining pings; no umbrella holds.

cards.name: La Sirena
cards.twist: The siren of the feed
cards.story: She doesn't sing anymore; she just shows you the next thing.
cards.grito_es: Ya no canta, nomás te enseña otra.
cards.grito_en: She doesn't sing; she just shows you one more.

cards.name: La Escalera
cards.twist: The corporate ladder
cards.story: Every rung is a back, and the top rung is a ceiling.
cards.grito_es: Sube y sube, y arriba hay techo.
cards.grito_en: Climb and climb, and at the top: a ceiling.

cards.name: La Botella
cards.twist: The bottled reward
cards.story: The thing you chase is always behind glass, and the cork is on the outside.
cards.grito_es: Lo que buscas está tras el vidrio.
cards.grito_en: What you chase is behind the glass.

cards.name: El Barril
cards.twist: The barrel of debt
cards.story: Lost everything except the barrel, and they're charging interest on that.
cards.grito_es: Perdió todo menos el barril, y ése también lo debe.
cards.grito_en: Lost all but the barrel, and he owes on that too.

cards.name: El Árbol
cards.twist: The tree that grows scratch-off tickets
cards.story: It drops a new crop every morning, and every leaf is almost a winner.
cards.grito_es: Rásquele a la hoja, que la raíz ya cobró.
cards.grito_en: Scratch the leaf; the root already got paid.

cards.name: El Melón
cards.twist: The melon slice on a string
cards.story: Someone pulls the sweetest piece away just as you reach for it, and calls it engagement.
cards.grito_es: La rebanada más dulce trae su hilito.
cards.grito_en: The sweetest slice comes with a little string.

cards.name: El Valiente
cards.twist: The brave one who bets it all
cards.story: He grips the losing ticket so hard it cuts him, and still calls it courage.
cards.grito_es: Valiente con el boleto; su sombra ya se fue.
cards.grito_en: Brave with the ticket; his shadow already left.

cards.name: El Gorrito
cards.twist: The bonnet left behind
cards.story: The cradle rocks itself now; someone left the tablet on.
cards.grito_es: La cuna se mece solita.
cards.grito_en: The cradle rocks all by itself.

cards.name: La Muerte
cards.twist: La Muerte, modern
cards.story: She never needed to chase anyone; she just waits for the battery to die.
cards.grito_es: No corre: espera que se acabe la pila.
cards.grito_en: She doesn't run; she waits for the battery to die.

cards.name: La Pera
cards.twist: The pear that is still loading
cards.story: Ripe any minute now, says the little wheel, and the old man keeps waiting.
cards.grito_es: Ya mero madura, dice la ruedita.
cards.grito_en: Almost ripe, says the little wheel.

cards.name: La Bandera
cards.twist: The flag of surrender
cards.story: Planted on a mountain of paperwork; it's the only flag they let you fly.
cards.grito_es: La única bandera que te dejan alzar.
cards.grito_en: The only flag they let you raise.

cards.name: El Bandolón
cards.twist: The bandolón that eats coins
cards.story: Every song it plays ends with the same note: the house wins.
cards.grito_es: Toca y toca, y siempre gana la casa.
cards.grito_en: It plays and plays, and the house always wins.

cards.name: El Violoncello
cards.twist: The cello in the empty ballroom
cards.story: He keeps playing for a party that ended years ago.
cards.grito_es: Toca para una fiesta que ya se acabó.
cards.grito_en: He plays for a party long since over.

cards.name: La Garza
cards.twist: The heron of the flooded lot
cards.story: She fishes where the strip mall used to be.
cards.grito_es: Pesca donde antes estaba la plaza.
cards.grito_en: She fishes where the mall used to be.

cards.name: El Pájaro
cards.twist: The canary that won't leave its cage
cards.story: The door has been open for years; the alerts keep her singing inside.
cards.grito_es: Puerta abierta y ni un saltito.
cards.grito_en: Door wide open, and not a single hop.

cards.name: La Mano
cards.twist: The palm that taps 'agree'
cards.story: Your fingerprint was the last signature they needed.
cards.grito_es: Una palomita y la huella ya no es tuya.
cards.grito_en: One little checkmark and the fingerprint isn't yours.

cards.name: La Bota
cards.twist: The executive boot
cards.story: Polished every morning on the backs of everyone below.
cards.grito_es: Bien boleada sobre la espalda de otros.
cards.grito_en: Polished bright on everyone else's back.

cards.name: La Luna
cards.twist: The moon that opened its eye
cards.story: You were never alone at night; that was the problem.
cards.grito_es: De noche no estás solo, y ése es el problema.
cards.grito_en: You're never alone at night, and that's the trouble.

cards.name: El Cotorro
cards.twist: The parrot that listens
cards.story: It repeats everything you say, to someone else.
cards.grito_es: Repite lo que dices, pero a otro.
cards.grito_en: He repeats what you say, to someone else.

cards.name: El Borracho
cards.twist: The drunk at the reels
cards.story: Not drunk on mezcal anymore. Drunk on almost.
cards.grito_es: Borracho de casi, no de mezcal.
cards.grito_en: Drunk on 'almost', not on mezcal.

cards.name: La Sombra
cards.twist: The sleeper's own shadow, cast by his phone (the old caricature card retired)
cards.story: The figure looming over the bed at 3am is you, holding the same light.
cards.grito_es: La sombra que te espanta trae tu mismo teléfono.
cards.grito_en: The shadow that scares you carries your same phone.

cards.name: El Corazón
cards.twist: The heart in the slot machine
cards.story: It pays out a beat at a time and never stops taking.
cards.grito_es: Late de a poquito y nunca deja de cobrar.
cards.grito_en: It beats a little at a time and never stops charging.

cards.name: La Sandía
cards.twist: The watermelon that plays the next episode
cards.story: Every seed is a play button, and the rind is starting to crack.
cards.grito_es: Otra semillita y otro capítulo.
cards.grito_en: Another little seed, another episode.

cards.name: El Tambor
cards.twist: The drum of the march to work
cards.story: Everyone marches in step; nobody remembers enlisting.
cards.grito_es: Todos marchan; nadie se acuerda de alistarse.
cards.grito_en: Everyone marches; no one remembers signing up.

cards.name: El Camarón
cards.twist: The shrimp asleep on the current
cards.story: Camarón que se duerme, se lo lleva la corriente: the feed is the current now.
cards.grito_es: Camarón que se duerme, se lo lleva el feed.
cards.grito_en: The shrimp who sleeps gets carried off by the feed.

cards.name: Las Jaras
cards.twist: The arrows of every ping
cards.story: A martyrdom of a thousand small alerts.
cards.grito_es: Mil flechitas, una por cada aviso.
cards.grito_en: A thousand little arrows, one per alert.

cards.name: El Músico
cards.twist: The musician nobody hears
cards.story: They all recorded it; nobody listened.
cards.grito_es: Todos lo grabaron, nadie lo oyó.
cards.grito_en: Everyone recorded him; no one listened.

cards.name: La Araña
cards.twist: The spider of the web
cards.story: The web is free; you are what it eats.
cards.grito_es: La red es gratis: tú eres la comida.
cards.grito_en: The web is free; you're the meal.

cards.name: El Soldado
cards.twist: The soldier of the warehouse
cards.story: He enlisted for the benefits; the war is the quota.
cards.grito_es: Se alistó por las prestaciones; la guerra es la cuota.
cards.grito_en: Joined for the benefits; the war is the quota.

cards.name: La Estrella
cards.twist: The star that drops a pin
cards.story: Sailors steered by her for centuries; now she steers them in circles.
cards.grito_es: Sigue a la estrellita, que da vueltas contigo.
cards.grito_en: Follow the little star; it goes in circles with you.

cards.name: El Cazo
cards.twist: The pot boiling over behind her back
cards.story: The stove doesn't need your eyes, until it does.
cards.grito_es: El cazo hierve, y tú ni volteas.
cards.grito_en: The pot boils, and you don't even turn around.

cards.name: El Mundo
cards.twist: The world in a snow globe
cards.story: Shake it and watch everyone call it weather.
cards.grito_es: Agítalo y dirán que es el clima.
cards.grito_en: Shake it and they'll call it weather.

cards.name: El Nahual
cards.twist: The nahual at the crossroads (the old caricature card retired)
cards.story: He was a man at the gas station; he's something else at the crossroads.
cards.grito_es: En la gasolinera es hombre; en el cruce, otra cosa.
cards.grito_en: A man at the gas station; something else at the crossroads.

cards.name: El Nopal
cards.twist: The nopal on the watched border
cards.story: It grew here first; now the cameras grow beside it.
cards.grito_es: Llegó primero; ahora las cámaras crecen junto.
cards.grito_en: It got here first; now cameras grow beside it.

cards.name: El Alacrán
cards.twist: The payday-loan scorpion
cards.story: Quick cash, slow poison.
cards.grito_es: Dinero rápido, veneno lento.
cards.grito_en: Quick cash, slow poison.

cards.name: La Rosa
cards.twist: The rose of eviction notices
cards.story: Somebody folded it beautifully before they changed the locks.
cards.grito_es: Bien doblada, antes de cambiar la chapa.
cards.grito_en: Folded beautifully, just before they changed the locks.

cards.name: La Calavera
cards.twist: The sugar skull with a casino inside
cards.story: The lights are always on in there.
cards.grito_es: Adentro las luces nunca se apagan.
cards.grito_en: Inside, the lights never go out.

cards.name: La Campana
cards.twist: The notification bell over town
cards.story: It rings and the whole town kneels.
cards.grito_es: Suena y todo el pueblo se arrodilla.
cards.grito_en: It rings and the whole town kneels.

cards.name: El Cantarito
cards.twist: The cracked jug drawing blue light
cards.story: You keep lowering it into the glow and it comes up empty every time.
cards.grito_es: Cántaro que va a la pantalla, rajado vuelve.
cards.grito_en: The jug that goes to the screen comes back cracked.

cards.name: El Venado
cards.twist: The stag in the headlights, antlers wired to the grid
cards.story: He stopped to look at the light; the whole herd is ghosts now.
cards.grito_es: Se paró a ver la luz; la manada ya es fantasma.
cards.grito_en: He stopped to see the light; the herd is ghosts now.

cards.name: El Sol
cards.twist: The sun that is a ring light
cards.story: It never sets, it just optimizes, and the room stays cold.
cards.grito_es: Sol de aro: alumbra, pero no calienta.
cards.grito_en: A ring-light sun: it shines, but it doesn't warm.

cards.name: La Corona
cards.twist: The crown of the house
cards.story: Every king of the betting floor was crowned with your rent.
cards.grito_es: Coronado con tu renta.
cards.grito_en: Crowned with your rent.

cards.name: La Chalupa
cards.twist: The flower boat on the dark canal
cards.story: She rows through the faces looking for one who looks up.
cards.grito_es: Rema entre caras buscando una que mire arriba.
cards.grito_en: She rows past faces, looking for one that looks up.

cards.name: El Pino
cards.twist: The pine that is a cell tower
cards.story: The forest is full of trees that aren't trees.
cards.grito_es: Árbol que no es árbol, bosque que escucha.
cards.grito_en: A tree that isn't a tree, a forest that listens.

cards.name: El Pescado
cards.twist: The fish hooked by its own words
cards.story: Por la boca muere el pez, and the line runs to a reply that's still typing.
cards.grito_es: Por la boca muere el pez, y por el comentario también.
cards.grito_en: The fish dies by its mouth, and by the comment too.

cards.name: La Palma
cards.twist: The palm painted on the cubicle wall
cards.story: The vacation lives on the wall, right where you can see it.
cards.grito_es: Las vacaciones viven en la pared.
cards.grito_en: The vacation lives on the wall.

cards.name: La Maceta
cards.twist: The potted employee
cards.story: Water daily. Repot never.
cards.grito_es: Riégalo diario, trasplántalo nunca.
cards.grito_en: Water daily; repot never.

cards.name: El Arpa
cards.twist: The harp strung with dead phones
cards.story: Every cable you pluck plays a call nobody answers.
cards.grito_es: Arpa de cables: cada cuerda, una llamada sin contestar.
cards.grito_en: A harp of cables: every string, an unanswered call.

cards.name: La Rana
cards.twist: The frog croupier
cards.story: He always pays out, just not to you.
cards.grito_es: Siempre paga, pero no a ti.
cards.grito_en: He always pays out, just not to you.
